brief:
Bank of Palestine and Al-Mutala Hospital launched a joint awareness campaign promoting early screening for prostate cancer, the Maan Wire reported. The initiative seeks to educate Palestinian men about the importance of regular checkups and early detection in identifying the disease at treatable stages.

Dr. Farah Awad, an oncology specialist at Al-Mutala Hospital, took part in the campaign announcement, offering medical perspective on screening methods and the clinical benefits of catching prostate cancer in its early phases. Health officials emphasized that timely diagnosis significantly improves treatment outcomes and patient survival rates.
